confluences: Confluence 1: Overlap of SMC Bullish Order Block, Supply and Demand zone mitigation, and Quarter Theory. Confluence 2: Integration of Break of Structure (BOS), Fair Value Gap (FVG), and Malaysian SNR (MSNR). The recent M5/M15 bullish expansion broke structure (BOS) above 1.16700, leaving behind an unmitigated Fair Value Gap (FVG) between 1.16646 and 1.16690. This FVG aligns with the MSNR support level at 1.16646 (the low of the H4 candle). Momentum indicators (RSI at 61.8) indicate that momentum remains bullish, validating a preemptive entry within the FVG before the next leg up.

Confluence 3: Alignment of Candle Range Theory (CRT), Candlestick Patterns, and Trendline Breaks & Bounces. Under Candle Range Theory, the current H4 range is defined by the high of 1.16753 and low of 1.16646. A retracement to 1.16655 places price in the deep discount zone (lower 25% of the range). This zone is reinforced by an ascending minor trendline from the 1.16515 low, where previous candlestick patterns showed strong lower rejection wicks. Volatility indicators (ATR of 0.00056) allow for a highly compressed, doctrine-compliant stop loss just below this structural confluence.

Confluence 4: Confluence of Chart Patterns, Supply/Demand, and SMC. The M15 chart pattern displays an ascending triangle/double bottom retest structure, where the previous resistance at 1.16700 has been broken and is now being retested as demand. SMC liquidity sweeps of the minor M5 lows are expected to terminate exactly at the defensive staff zone. This is supported by volume indicators (OBV/Volume), which show decreasing volume on the current pullback, indicating a lack of selling pressure and imminent bullish continuation.

Confluence 5: Mathematical precision via Fibonacci Retracement, Standard Deviation (SD), and Quarter Theory. The entry price of 1.16655 represents a precise 0.5 Fibonacci retracement of the recent swing from 1.16515 to 1.16753. This level is further validated by the 1-SD lower boundary of the short-term distribution and the lower band of the Bollinger Bands, which are contracting to form a squeeze. This multi-layered volatility and mathematical alignment ensures a highly predictive wick-rejection point.
